sampling: Five rotated matched sets, fresh browser contexts/source owners, existing generated source source reads delayed10ms. Existing exact-AVIO-byte plus independent paused-picture run must pass before accepting these measurements. Same0.5x playback,1.2sec paused observation,4x distant seek, source identity change rejection and cleanup per variant.
R003_metric: Actual source request count and observed fetched bytes across equal initial+seek work. Require median request count reduction>=20% while fetched-byte increase<=30%. Record abandoned/discarded read bytes from reader stats. This is a request/byte cost gate, no CPU/energy claim.
R026_metric: Timer-boundary invocations in same1.2sec fully buffered pause. Require>=90% paired reduction, no missed play/seek wake or output-control failure. Timer invocation count is not CPU or physical energy.
R049_metric: Prepared compressed bytes and contiguous media-seconds retained at0.5x pause. Require>=20% fewer prepared bytes, no active playback/4x-seek progress or fidelity regression; charge additional4x preparation and final abandoned source bytes separately. No starvation-resilience claim without delayed-release traces.
limits: Counters are narrowly scoped work/retention measures; no product-wide adoption, physical memory/energy, packet-loss or true-network-abandoned-byte claim. Browser source-route callback delay is controlled but loopback throughput is not representative of networks.
